messages:
Maria G.: heads-up — nightly eval for model-3a v2 (int8) shows a big quality dip on the 'customer-support' prompt set, ~18% failure rate vs 2% baseline :grimacing:
Izzy K.: ugh. same eval harness & seed as before? any repro artifacts?
Maria G.: yes same harness. only change was enabling KV prefix caching + increased dynamic batching (batch_size=8 -> 16). failures look like truncated or repeated assistant messages.
Stefan L.: can you paste a failing example? might be determinism issue with shared KV entries across requests when batching reorders prefixes.
Maria G.: here's one from the logs (sanitized):
```
REQUEST  ts=1765004300  model=model-3a-v2-int8  batch_id=1147  prefixes=["Ticket: #1234\nCustomer:"]
RESPONSE assistant: "Thanks for reaching out. To reset your...To reset your...To reset your..."
CACHE_HIT kv_key=sha256(prefix+model+sess)  hit_from_prefix_cache=true
```
Izzy K.: That repeated chunk looks like a KV cache replay bug. Possible double-insert when multiple prefixes map to same shard?
EvalBot: nightly-eval summary: model-3a-v2-int8 — overall pass rate 81.7%, regression relative to yesterday -15.3%. Top failure buckets: customer-support (18%), math-short (6%).
Taylor S.: what was the batching config? iirc we recently rolled a change that coalesces prefixes into a single cache key if below min_prefix_len.
Maria G.: batching config: `batch_size=16, batch_timeout_ms=12, prefix_min_len=12` — many customer-support prompts have short prefixes ("Hi,")
Stefan L.: possible triage plan: 1) reproduce locally with `batch_size=16` and KV cache enabled 2) run with batch_size=1 to see if failures disappear 3) add extra cache key entropy (session id) to confirm collision hypothesis
Izzy K.: i can run repro in the morning cluster. quick check: are we reusing `prefix_key = hash(prefix)` without model/seq meta?
Maria G.: yes older code hashed only prefix. new change was trying to reduce key space and accidentally removed model id.
OpsBot: FYI deploy-audit: commit 9f3b2c toggled `kv_prefix_keying` on prod clusters at 03:40 UTC (yesterday).
Taylor S.: ok that explains. simplest hotfix is to roll back that commit or re-enable model id in key derivation.
Stefan L.: also want to check batching reorder: if we reorder requests before caching we might pollute other requests' kv entries. add strict per-request tag in cache for safety.
Maria G.: agree. for immediate mitigation i've opened a canary to disable prefix cache for model-3a-v2-int8 and lowered batch_size to 4 on nightly runners. will post results in ~30m.
Izzy K.: thanks — i'll run deterministic reproducer after the canary. if fails go to rollback.
EvalBot: canary-run update: after disabling prefix cache for model-3a-v2-int8 nightly pass rate -> 98.9% (pre-regression baseline 99.2%).
Maria G.: awesome. follow-ups: 1) revert the keying change or include model+sess in key 2) add unit tests for cross-batch KV isolation 3) add smoke test to nightly that exercises short-prefix edgecases
Taylor S.: i'll file a PR for the key fix and tests. tagging @stefan for review.
Stefan L.: will review. also propose adding an internal debug metric `kv_prefix_conflicts` to surface these fast.
Maria G.: thanks all. logging this thread into the eval triage doc and linking the failing samples. :thumbsup:
